tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na ma ār+ya tā rā yai/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs rje yis// byang chub bsgrub la bar du gcod byed pa// 'chi bdag las rgyal gnas skabs mthar thug gi /dngos grub mchog stsol rje btsun ma la 'dud// 'dir dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bsal te 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ yid bzhin 'khor lo 'di nyid bsgrub cing bsnyen par byed pa la/ yid ches par byed pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ brgyud pa de nyid las byung ba'i sgrub thabs gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung ba paṇa chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags/ des bla ma gser gling pa/ des paṇ+ṭi ta dī paṃ ka ra/ des 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ des spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ des sgres pa rin po che/ des rje sgam po pa/ des dpal phag mo gru pa/ des stag lung thang pa/ des bla ma ba lam pa/ des slob dpon tshal pa/ des shaka gzhon pa/ des don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ des bla ma bsod nams rdo rje/ des 'khrul zhig blo bzang grags pa/ de la skyes mchog smon lam pa dang*/ grub chen rdo rje dpal ldan gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis la grub chen blo gros chos rgyal gyis gsan/ de la yongs 'dzin dam pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po gsan/ des dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ngag gi dang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan la'o// gnyis pa brgyud pa de nyid las byung ba'i sgrub thabs la/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum sgrub/ rjes su gnang ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su mthun rkyen 'dzom par byas la/ ra ba bzhi'am rtag par yang rung ste/ sa byi dor byas// gnas brgyan/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan sngar/ mchod rdzas bzang po kha na ma tho ba'i skyon dang bral ba dang*/ gtor ma dkar gsum rin po che'i snod du bshams/ khrus byas gtsang sbra dang ldan pas stan bde ba la sems skyil gyis 'dug la/

mdun du nyer spyod rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa bzhag thog mar bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma phul la/ phrin las bcol nas bsnyen bsgrub la 'jug pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog dngos// bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs pad la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs kun// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// zhes lan ci rigs kyi rjes su/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal las bsgral zhing*// bde ba mchog la rab bkod de// bla med byang chub la bzhag phyir// sgo gsum dge la bskul bar bya// rang nyid skad cig gis pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su taṃ yig dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las ar+ghaṃ gyi dod du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ d+dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta zhes bkod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i dang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma mchog tu yangs pa'i steng du/

a las zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su tāṃ dkar po gnas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bsal 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/rang nyid tshe dpal bsod nams mtha' dag rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma ston zla'i 'od dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan dkyus ring zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras yid du 'ong ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas ut+pa la dkar po yal 'dab rgyas pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs su bcings pa'i lhag ma g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba lo bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol mnga' ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i cha smad du hūṃ/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla gdan la tāṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod paṇa gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta ga ta a bhi ṣi ñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa gyur/

bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'bum gyi nang ma la/ ā li bcu drug g.yon bskor bar pa la/ kā li so bzhi g.yas bskor/ phyi ma la/ ye dharmā g.yas su 'khor ba'i yig 'bru rab tu dkar ba las 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing dang mchin kha drug rim gyis spros pas/ lus gang*/ phyi rol tu bar thag 'dom re tsam nas 'od kyi gur khyim gyi rnam pa drug tu gyur pa'i bar mtshams thams cad ut+pa la sngon po gsar du kha byes gang ba/ 'od kyi kha dog gi dbye bas zhi rgyas dbang drag las thams cad brtan byed kyi nus ldan du bsgom/ de ltar bu'i dmigs pas cung zad ngal ba'i tshe/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags ci nus su bzla ba dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma a yu r+dz+nyā na pu n+ya puṣ+ṭi ku su ru swā hā/ zhes pa ngag thun du bcad nas brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa gang 'grub bzla'o// de yang bgrang phreng ni/ pad+ma'i rigs la pad+ma'i snying*/ zhes pa dang mthun pa grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa gsum bsgril la brgyus pa/ dri bzang gi chus bkrus te snyim par bzung nas/ oṃ ba su ma ri shrī ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs pa/ thun gyi thog mar lan re bya yi/ thams cad du ni mi dgos so// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥpad+mānata kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wār i daṃ ba l+ya di kha kha khā hi khā hi/

gsum gyis phul la 'dod gsol ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar gcod ni// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ mchog rnams sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// tshul des zhag nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs par bsnyen par byas na/ rmi lam du mchod rten grangs nges can nam/ nges med gang byung yang 'chi bdag bzlog par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa mdun skyed bum bsgrub ni/ yid dang mthun par gnas su bla bre yol ba sogs bkod pa'i khyad par dang ldan pas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar bya/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las mdun du zhing khams pho brang bkod pa tshad med pa'i dbus su/ tshe dpal bsod nams rab tu 'phel zhes pa nas rgyas gdab kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes pa'i sh+loka brjod pas phyag 'tshal/ mchod yon me tog mkha' khyab dri zhim spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams bkang byas te// bla ma bcom ldan ma la 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ mdzes pa'i gzugs mchog sgra snyan dri zhim dang*/ ro brgya ldan dang srab 'jam reg mchog sogs// kun bzang mchod sprin dang mtshungs sna tshogs kyis// chos dbyings kun bkang bcom ldan ma la 'bul/ sngags kyi thog mtha' sngar bzhin las ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ rā se/ spar+she/ bi shwa/ zhes brjod/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran ni// mchod rdzas du mas yongs bkang ste// bla ma bcom ldan 'das ma ni// dus rnam rtag tu mchod par bgyi// oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/

rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can/ zhes pa nas/ yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bdun rnam dag bya/ gtor ma bsangs byin gyis brlabs nas dbul/ gsol gdab sngar bzhin bya/ sku gsum rgyal ba ma lus kun gyi yum// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig ma// dus gsum bla ma mchog gi ngo bo nyid// rigs gsum 'phags ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes sh+lo ka brjod pas phyag 'tshal/ bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs ldan zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni ye ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar gcod dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/

snod bcud la phog pas tshe dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par gyur/ dmigs pa dang lhan cig tu bzlas pa bya/ rin po che'i bum pa bkrus/ spos kyis bdugs/ srog chags med pa'i chus bkang*/ bum rdzas bcug pa'i steng du mchod yon gzungs thag sogs bshams/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan la/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad rab tu 'phel zhes pa nas rgyas gdab kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin la sngags kyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kar yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i 'od kyis/ brtan g.yo ma lus pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams thams cad bsdus te thim par gyur/ bzlas pa ci rigs grub nas mchod pa 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ gsum pa rjes su gnang ba ni/ dus dge ba gza' skar bzang po dang dang ldan pa'i tshe/ sku gzugs bshams/ mchod pa'i bkod pas gnas brgyan/ dri bzang gi byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po lte ba ljang ser/ mu khyud gong ras ji ltar mdzes pa'i dbus su tāṃ yig ge me tog dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dung chos su dri chab la sngags bzlas pa dang*/ bdag skyed mdun bskyed/ bum bsgrub rnams sngon du 'gro bas slob ma rnams la dung chos kyi chab kyis khrus bya maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa dang tshe'i dngos grub kyi ched du bcom ldan 'das ma'i rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i mos pas rjes zlos kyi/ 'khor ba las sgrol zhes pa nas/ ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod ces pa'i bar lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bla ma 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor gsal ba la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'bul snyam pas/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams tshe dpal bsod nams zhes pa nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bsgo/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das ma dang tha mi dad par mos te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches bdag gi dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad bsal nas/ rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i yig 'bru las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo yig 'bru'i rnam par byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar thim/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru las/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa de 'dra ba dpag med byung de khyed rang rnam pa'i snying ka'i 'khor lo la thim/ thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad dag /'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ spos kyis bdug rol mo bya/ de nas oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ sngags kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas// de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams ma/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka tas ma ye shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ chu'i lha ga ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan par gyur/

oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ yang dpon slob gnyis ka rje btsun mar gsal ba'i bla ma'i zhal nas sngags mu tig gi 'phreng ba lta bu 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim/ rje btsun ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs dngos grub thob/ ngag sngags kyi mthu ldan du bsgom/ yi ge bcu pa brgya bzlas/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing pad+ma'i steng gi me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng mang po spyan drangs la khyed rang rnams kyi snying kar thim pas/ phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa'i nus ldan gyi ye shes mngon du byas snyam pa'i mos pa gyis/ zhes brda sprad/ de nas de phyin chad snying po yi ge bcu pa spel tshig dang bcas pa chags med du bzla ba'i yi dam long*/ zhes bsgom/ ji tsam nus pa'i dam bca' 'bul du bcug la 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar gzung ba dang*/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ phyag g.yon 'bul/ de ltar rjes su gnang ba grub nas/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ badz+ra tā re sa ma ya zhes sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa 'khor bcas badz+ra muḥ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/

rgyal mchog tshe dpag med pa'i yum/ 'chi med nges par ster ba mo// rig pa 'dzin ma bcom ldan 'das// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /bdag dang skye dgu thams cad la// 'jigs pa kun las rab grol zhing*// phan dang bde ba rab 'phel bas// 'dod don kun 'grub bkra shis shog /'jigs pa kun las thar ba dang*// thun mong dngos grub sna tshogs pa// bde blag nyid du 'grub gyur ste// rang gzhan rnams la phan byed shog /ces bkra shis smon lam rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bya'o// rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di nyid chos mchog rgyal po dang nor bu rab 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang gzhan 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir du// spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po dang*/ yongs 'dzin dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po ngag gi dbang pos mdzad pa las nyung ngur bsdus te/ ngag dbang nor bus gdan sa chen po ra lung thel gyi kun dga' ra bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bla ma rgya mtshos bgyis pa 'dis kyang*/ sems can thams cad dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang bral nas rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
